player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ HighSociety agorɔ (2-player version) mu.
Agorɔ no fa:  Prestige kaadɛ du wɔ auction mu baako baako.
Bidding:    Auction biara, ɛyɛ a wode kaadɛ 1-11 sɛ kɔkɔɔ na wokyerɛ.
            • Ɛdeɛ a ɛkɔ soro no na ɛnya prestige kaadɛ no na wogu kaadɛ no.
            • Ɛdeɛ a ɛba fam no na ɛkora kaadɛ no.
            • Tie -> mmienu no bɛsan kɔm na prestige kaadɛ no bɛsan auction.
Nkontabuo:    Auction du no akyi, ka **sika a aka + prestige mma**.
            Ɛdeɛ a ɛkɔ soro *net-worth* no na ɛnya (tie pɛpɛɛpɛ -> draw).

**Action syntax**  →  bid kaadɛ baako sɛ '[7]' anaa '[11]'.

board.money_cards: Wo sika nkrataa a aka no: {money}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mepɔ wɔn hyɛ da biara mu [X] sika card.

message.tie: Wɔsan de nea wɔabɔ ho ka no bae.
message.auction_result: P0 bɔ {bid0}, P1 bɔ {bid1}. Player {winner} di prestige {prize} (ɔha {total}).
